principles: Push to origin/dev; never docker cp — the substrate self-updates from git (feedback-substrate-self-updates-from-git, 07-24)
FP-test any hard-fail gate on the real corpus and put the count in the commit (feedback-test-hard-fail-gates, 08-02)
Verified-and-correct first reach → donor → reuse → compounding; locate the first broken link before measuring the last (first-reach-is-the-gate, 08-08)
Pin the HEAD of every vessel measured, at start and end (08-08)
When a change is justified by a measurement, check the code performs that measurement (08-08)
A learning curve can be a defect-compensation curve; decompose before crediting the learner (08-08)
A catch must change the caller's status, not return a plausible value (FOUR-FAILURE-CLASSES, 08-04)
Prove the path executed; declaration is not evidence (08-04)
An oracle must be derivable from goal text, never from the artifact; 'by construction' is the bug (08-04)
Never fix the drafter with the drafter; never route an auth fix through auth (08-04)
An instrument lands before the thing it measures (session-priority-queue, 08-04)
Grade the layer that was wrong, not the layer still reachable (feedback-plane note)
A landed commit is inert until the unit restarts; compare ActiveEnterTimestamp to mtime (feedback-plane note)
Timers are an antipattern; all self-operations run on rhythms as shapes (08-01)
Fix a lossy remote store with location independence, not repatriation (07-05)
Test at the layer that consumes the artifact (seven-instances, 08-20)
Verify landings against origin; the gap store window is not a ledger (07-12)
Reach is verified by downstream consumption; honesty of the grade precedes intelligence of the choice; a hollow green is negative value (07-20/21)
Honest grade must hold in both the return and the durable training trace (07-21)
A wrong mint is negative value, not zero (07-10)
Never raise a startup-gate timeout for slow work; spoke-safe ≠ hub-safe; deploying a fix needs the substrate up (hub-restart-loop, 08-03)
In-band gates cannot make a self-modifying system safe; safety must be out of band (08-03) — later branch protection declined, strategy is detection (08-04)
A false reach is positive credit that keeps a failing family alive (ribosome-drain, 08-02)
When a blocker moves three times, run one manual dispatch that splits the hypothesis space (08-02)
Verify where a write lands before naming the store it corrupts; two zeros discriminate caller vs dependency (goal-generation, 08-03)
A clean recreate is the only way to surface persisted-state↔runtime drift (db-management, 07-23)
Durable removal = neutralize the source DEFINE, not a DB drop (07-23)
Correlation at cadence ≠ cause (surreal-oom, 07-22)
Bootstrap edits only survive if committed and pushed (07-22)
Warn-and-continue must keep never-applied distinguishable from empty (six-schemas, 08-03)
Disposition is learned by selecting behaviors under conditions; the selector IS the router (interaction-patterns, 07-14)
Consequential action ⇒ activity; thin resolvers only for read/transform/atomic-write (07-14)
One hunk per goal with verbatim anchors; multi-hunk goals drop parts (self-dev-cycle, 07-18)
One change per commit/measurement; pre-register the prediction (phased-coax-roadmap, 07-19)
Subtract first: revive dead wiring before adding shapes past spectral headroom (sequencing-spine critic, 07-20)
Small-inconsistency class = severed credit-graph edges: emitted∧¬read, read∧¬emitted, defined-twice (07-20)
Subagents on a live substrate must be explicitly forbidden from writing (08-02)

Operating model: use existing resolvers first, route around holes, encapsulate on evidence, chain outputs onward, build general tools at shared seams; done = end-to-end across nodes; the same issue recurring for the same reason is the failure (operating-model, 09-29)
